title: Lend Me your ears
author: Ok-Investment4414
selftext:
Sup folks could use some input. Starting my game this coming week and want to get input on which route to take. These will all be browser games ran from my own dedicate server(saying that I'm not depending on a platforms engine or rules).There will also be an app version , just not quite sure the route for that as yet . Leaning towards the Feudal era game but here are my 3 choice.

Feudal Era Progression Fantasy you play as a no body and need to rise up through the realm - think game of thrones 

Cyberpunk Dystopia - you get unthawed and living life 50 - 100 years later - think cyberpunk edge runners / blade runner

Post Apocalyptical WW3 sim - trying to survive post world war 3 ( bio weapons)  think the walking dead 

The game would run seasonal 3 - 6 months per season based on player activity that propels an ending. It's player vs player vs npcs vs ai .
